description: This file defines utility functions for the Git::SVN Perl module, including path and URL canonicalization, checking for optional module availability, and some string/path manipulations. It exports functions like fatal, can_compress, canonicalize_path, canonicalize_url, join_paths, and add_path_to_url.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints a message to standard error and exits with code 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks if the Compress::Zlib module is available, indicating support for compression.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a file path into a canonical form suitable for SVN API calls, using SVN's own functions if available, or a custom implementation.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into a canonical form safe for SVN API, using SVN's own function if available or a custom implementation.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple paths into one, ensuring proper slashes.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a relative path to a base URL, escaping '%' characters in the path.
